title: NASA Overhead
description: A daily NASA briefing for Canada: Earth from L1, this week's asteroid flybys, aurora odds for your places, solar activity and open natural events.

data_info.detail: A daily build fetches NASA APOD, NeoWs, DONKI, EPIC and EONET data plus NOAA's Kp forecast; aurora thresholds for your places are calculated in the browser.
